mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever wondered why a simple melody can give you chills, or how a favorite song can bring back memories you'd almost forgotten? Welcome to this journey where we're about to explore the mysterious power of music—how it moves us, heals us, and even shapes who we are. Together, we'll dive into stories that blur the lines between health and illness, showing how music can become a lifeline for some and a source of wonder for all. Along the way, we'll discover insights from Oliver Sacks in his captivating book, Musicophilia: Tales of Music and the Brain. Through his eyes, music isn't just an art form—it's a force that weaves itself into our minds, touching memory, emotion, and identity in ways you might never expect. You'll hear about people whose brains respond to music in the most extraordinary ways—from sudden musical gifts after injury, to the comfort songs bring to those with memory loss, and even the strange world of musical obsessions. Each story invites us to see just how adaptable and resilient the human mind can be. So, as we explore these remarkable encounters between music and the brain, let's reflect together on what it truly means to be human—and how the universal language of music connects, heals, and transforms us all.
